messages.subject: Red-R has a new home and forum
messages.subject_clean: Red-R has a new home and forum
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Thanks for your support during the early stage development of Red-R.
We have moved to a new website and forum system at: http://www.red-r.org
We have a much improved version of Red-R available at http://www.red-r.org/downloads.

Thanks,
Red-R Development Team
